text.title: Pattern
text.body: Coordinate #3: 20 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_rests_on_repeated_acts: Pattern arises where operations have repeated — no structure without recurrence. Its ground is #2 done again and again until a shape shows through, and beneath that the void's standing offer of order.
properties.q_1_the_structure_itself: Pattern is the archetype of structure — the which, the logic, the repeatable shape. In the matheme it is 'I have knowledge of difference': the live act congealed into a thing one can hold, teach, store — knowledge as deposit rather than deed.
properties.q_2_operates_by_recognition: Pattern works by matching — 'which shape fits this?' It is the canonical scouring, the recognition that reads a new case against a held form. To pattern is to recognise; to recognise is to find the which already waiting.
properties.q_3_the_nominalised_form: Pattern is the formal-structural position as such — the which, the logic that organises. It is Lacan's bar fallen: the live knowing become knowledge, signifier over signified (S/s), the deposit that never fully coincides with the act it came from. Structure as such — lawful, transmissible, and, left alone, in danger of forgetting it was ever a verb.
properties.q_4_for_the_sake_of_transmission: Pattern is for keeping — it lets a hard-won act be taught, repeated, carried across generations; the condition under which there is such a thing as inherited knowledge at all. Without the noun, nothing survives the one who knew it.
properties.q_5_must_be_re_animated: Pattern integrates into Context (#4), but its synthesis carries a warning: the deposit can ossify. A pattern completes truly only when it is re-taken — the noun re-opened into its verb — the recovery #4 performs. Held but not re-animated, knowledge becomes dead data; #3 hands the live problem forward.
